title: Omnichannel Automated SMS: Let an AI Profile Qualify Leads by Text | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
The first text to a new lead does not have to come from a person. An automatic activity load gives each contact to an AI profile that sends the opening text, holds the conversation, follows up when the customer goes quiet, and completes the activity with a disposition and a summary. The same profile can answer the customers who text you first.

In this video:
• Why automate texts, and what the AI profile does
• Starting an AI profile from Qualify leads by text
• The automatic activity load: AI profile, reply delay, re-engagement cadence, business hours, channel and address
• Loading the activities, and the background task that sends the opening text
• Opt-outs, no-response timeouts and reply delays
• Routing a text entry point to an AI agent
• Disposition, summary, Review AI conversation and live agent handoff
